blurb: Guests can experience tandem skydiving from up to 14,000 ft with views of Lake Michigan and Chicago skyline. The center offers AFF training to earn a solo skydiving license and services for licensed skydivers including coach jumps and gear rentals. Facilities include indoor packing, rigging and repairs, vending machines, and a large landing area with pickup.
extraNote: $39 deposit to book tandem or AFF; balance due on jump day · 100% refundable if paid directly to Skydive Windy City · Reservations highly recommended; walk-ins not guaranteed · No personal cameras allowed on tandem jumps; allowed if experienced with 200+ jumps · Michigan City Municipal Airport

quotes.text: My tandem skydive was an unforgettable experience. From start to finish, the instructors were professional, calm, and reassuring, which made all the difference. Everything was clearly explained, safety was prioritized, and I felt supported every step of the way. Even through the fear, I felt completely safe. I highly recommend this drop zone to anyone considering their first jump or a return jump.

This place is great! The location is really convenient and you get a good view of the lake and Chicago in the distance on a clear day. The staff I've dealt with have all been super friendly and cool too. I'll be going back again soon.
I have done it twice already. Each time with my kids who were turning 18 years of age. It's kind a tradition in our family. Great experience and awesome staff and instructors. Lots of fun.
Kirk was AWESOME. It was my first time and he was super cool and chill and made me feel relaxed. By the time we got up in the air I wasn’t as nervous.
I can't sing my praises enough about this place. Amazing instructors, amazing atmosphere, amazing views. Just overall amazing experience!
After jumping at other facilities I'd have to say this is one of the best.
